name: Little Crossroads
description:
About This Game

Welcome to Little Crossroads, a peaceful multiplayer sandbox where you can build a home, progress and develop your skills, and explore a vibrant world full of friendship.

With a variety of skills to develop like Fishing, Bug Catching, Mining, Woodcutting, and Foraging, you’re free to wander, explore, and grow however you like.

But your path will be influenced by the fantastic rewards that await you:

  • Pets that are both cute AND helpful, like the "Grolem", a dirt Golem that acts as a mobile farm. Grow wherever you go!

  • Powerful upgrades like Wings, Boats, and super-powered Tools.

  • Cosmetic Items that dazzle and inspire.

  • And much more.

Will you spend your days fishing by the river, chasing butterflies through sun-dappled fields, or mining rare gems deep in the mountains?

At the heart of Little Crossroads lies a quiet freedom to find your path... at your own pace.

Each Player owns their own Little Crossroads, and at its center lies a magical signpost allowing travel to and from the worlds of other Players. Team up with friends—old or new—to build, fish, gather, and relax together in real-time multiplayer.

Share the journey with others, or enjoy it solo.

🎨 Show Off your Creative Flair 🎨

Express yourself with robust customization, both inside and out.

  • Design your character with a range of cute and cool outfits, hairstyles, and accessories.

  • Build and decorate your Crossroads and Homestead with crafted furniture and seasonal flair.

  • Whether you're planting daisies or placing a tea set just so, Little Crossroads gives you the tools to make your world feel like home.

🗿 A Mysterious Origin? 🗿

What is this place, actually? And who created the magical signposts at the Crossroads that connects these parallel paradises?

Discover evidence and unravel the mystery, if that suits you.

Or, let it be, and enjoy the opportunity with no strings attached.

🌟 Wishlist and Follow Along 🌟

The world of Little Crossroads is still growing, and we’d love to have you along for the journey.

Add us to your Wishlist to follow development, updates, and future playtests!

The Crossroads are waiting. What path will you take?
short_desc: Escape the rush of your other life in this multiplayer Cozy RPG. Advance in a deep progression of skills like Fishing, Mining, and Bug Catching. Unlock cute and cool cosmetics to customize your character. Experience the "cozy chaos" of random events. All solo or with friends. Welcome home!
